directAnswer: Connect your DeX-capable Samsung device to a monitor using a USB-C to HDMI cable or a compatible hub, then start Samsung DeX from the notification prompt on your device.
summary: Samsung DeX allows you to use your Galaxy device as a desktop-like experience on an external monitor. A wired connection is the most reliable method, though wireless options are available for compatible devices.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.body: Ensure you have a Samsung device that supports DeX, such as recent Galaxy S, Note, or Tab models. You'll need a monitor with HDMI or USB-C input and a cable or hub that supports video output.

sections.heading: Connection Methods
sections.body: Wired connections provide the best performance. Use a USB-C to HDMI cable or a USB-C hub with HDMI output. Wireless DeX is available on compatible smart TVs or via the DeX app on Windows PCs.

steps.title: Choose the right cable or hub
steps.detail: Select a USB-C to HDMI cable or a USB-C hub with HDMI output that supports video transmission. Avoid charge-only cables.

steps.title: Connect your device to the monitor
steps.detail: Plug the cable into your Samsung device and the monitor. If using a hub, connect the hub to the monitor and your device.

steps.title: Start Samsung DeX
steps.detail: Unlock your device and look for the DeX notification. Tap it to start DeX mode. Alternatively, go to Settings > Samsung DeX to manually start it.

steps.title: Adjust display settings
steps.detail: In DeX mode, access settings to adjust resolution and screen options. Ensure the monitor is set to the correct input source.

faqs.question: Why is my monitor not displaying anything?
faqs.answer: Ensure the cable supports video output and the monitor is set to the correct input source. Try a different cable or port if necessary.

faqs.question: Can I use DeX wirelessly?
faqs.answer: Yes, if you have a compatible smart TV or use the DeX app on a Windows PC. Ensure both devices are on the same Wi-Fi network.

caveats: Not all Samsung devices support DeX; check your device's specifications.
Some apps may not fully support DeX mode and could display in a smaller window.
